segments.name: Asset Management
segments.description: Designs, issues and manages regulated exchange-listed digital asset investment products for institutional and retail investors.
segments.evidence: The Asset Management segment comprises the Group's regulated digital-asset investment products, including its suite of ETPs and exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that provide investors with exchange-listed exposure to cryptocurrencies and blockchain-related themes.

segments.name: Capital Markets
products: staking and lending of digital assets
segments.description: Runs trading, liquidity and balance-sheet activities that support the platform and earn yield through staking and lending.
segments.evidence: The Capital Markets segment is the Group's trading, liquidity, and balance-sheet deployment engine, focused on proprietary trading and arbitrage, staking and lending of digital assets, treasury/liquidity management, and other yield- and spread-generating activities that support the broader platform.

revenueModel.text: Investors pay management fees accruing daily on assets under management, and Capital Markets earns trading, staking, lending and liquidity provisioning returns.
revenueModel.evidence: Recurring Asset Management revenues, derived primarily from management fees accruing daily based on assets under management

changes.text: From 2025, the operating information given to the chief operating decision maker changed to align with the current view of the business.
changes.evidence: Beginning in 2025, the operating information provided to the CODM changed to align with the current view of the business.
